errors.evidence: The color of the 'Self-RAG' bar is tan or beige, not brown.
The description incorrectly merges the labels for two separate bars, 'FactTune' and 'CInGS (w/)', into one label 'FactTuneCInGS (w/)'. The green bar corresponds only to the 'FactTune' category.
The bar corresponding to 'CInGS' is a bright, saturated blue, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: and are sorted in the order they appear on the x-axis
errors.evidence: This phrase is tautological and awkward. It is an unclear way of stating that the bars are not sorted by value.
